ranges.notes: PostgreSQL 9.0 to 9.6. Patch series are empty until the ports for this era land (CDB-25, CDB-28).
PostgreSQL 10 to 12. Patch series are empty until the ports for this era land (CDB-26, CDB-29).
PostgreSQL 13 and 14. Patch series are empty until the ports for this era land (CDB-27, CDB-30).
PostgreSQL 15: the 16 series ported by scripts/port-patches.js; the snowball patch is made by scripts/make-snowball-patch.js (patches/*/pg15/ are the patches that needed it).
PostgreSQL 16: the 18.x series, ported by scripts/port-patches.js (docs/patches.md); entries in patches/*/pg16/ are the patches that needed it.
PostgreSQL 17: the 18.x series, ported by scripts/port-patches.js (docs/patches.md); entries in patches/*/pg17/ are the patches that needed it.
Baseline: the 18.x patch series (CDB-3, CDB-6) live in the default series files.
